description: This file is a shell script for testing the git-format-patch command's numbering options, including different configurations and behaviors for patch numbering in git format patches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, takes a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_num_no_numbered
methods.description: Checks the number of patches with a specific subject pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_single_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that a single patch file has no numbering in its subject line.

methods.name: test_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that multiple patches have no numbering in their subject lines.

methods.name: test_single_cover_letter_numbered
methods.description: Checks that a cover letter patch is numbered correctly.

methods.name: test_single_numbered
methods.description: Checks that a single patch is numbered.

methods.name: test_numbered
methods.description: Checks that multiple patches are numbered sequentially.
